title: 亚托克斯·赤翼天门
description: 赤黑暗裔立于空旷石门前，收拢巨翼，双手扶住垂直静置的大剑，侧光勾出甲面与角冠。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Aatrox is a towering Darkin with crimson and charcoal armor-like surfaces, a sharply horned head, luminous eyes, powerful adult humanoid proportions, and immense batlike wings. Preserve his elongated facial structure, imposing shoulder silhouette, and integrated fully covering armored body. His distinctive enormous dark-red greatsword is held vertically with its tip resting on stone, completely inactive.
art_direction.scene: Place him alone beneath a monumental open stone gateway, feet planted apart and wings folded into tall angular planes behind his shoulders. Both hands rest on the pommel of the grounded sword. A hard shaft of sunset enters from the left, dividing his armor into bold wax-crayon facets; distant pale cliffs and broad empty sky create immense uncluttered depth.
art_direction.palette: crimson, charcoal violet, copper rim light, pale stone
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
